title: A Wave-Substrate Computer: Phase-Coded Information, Settling as Computation, and a Layered Test of Functional General Intelligence
abstract: A clock-free wave-substrate computer in which information is carried by oscillator phase and computation is the physics settling to a fixed point. Nine layers (L0–L9) test, falsifiably and without tuning, whether the brain’s wave-medium properties suffice for functional general intelligence; the capability ladder closes 6/7→7/7 and the eight inherited invariants compress to a minimal, irreducible five. Firewall: function only, the hard problem open.
headline_results: information = phase θ (not a bit); settling = computation

chapters.title: The wave-substrate thesis: compute by phase, match by physics settling
chapters.one_liner: Phase carries information and settling is the computation; the bet that this suffices for general function was tested layer by layer.

chapters.title: Method: no tuning, a stress test for every claim, and bit-for-bit reproduction
chapters.one_liner: Inherited numbers are principles not fitting targets; every claim survives a breaking test; all twelve sims reproduce bit-for-bit.

chapters.title: L0 — the proven substrate: storage, computation, pattern, and communication by phase
chapters.one_liner: The substrate stores, computes, holds many patterns and communicates at negative SNR; the sum is the information, matching is O(1)-in-P, learning is one-shot.

chapters.title: L1 — the representation algebra: bind, bundle, and permute on the wave field
chapters.one_liner: bind, bundle and permute form a closed wave algebra; a sequence of length L*≈32 is read back by position, but role-value trees are shallow (depth d*≈2-4).

chapters.title: L2 — time and sequence: metastable trajectories and a working-memory capacity law
chapters.one_liner: Asymmetric coupling makes the field walk a learned loop (replay 1.0 at λ≈2.5) and working-memory capacity = min(slots, precision), landing in the Miller range 4-9.

chapters.title: L3 — hierarchy and abstraction: nested phase coupling breaks the flat ceiling
chapters.one_liner: A slow phase gates which fast sub-field is active: it selects the level (margin +0.92), recognizes categories from novel instances, composes with zero gap, and multiplies capacity ~6x.

chapters.title: L4 — the pivot: resonance inference without computation
chapters.one_liner: The gate derives itself from a raw cue; constraint satisfaction is settling (1.0 ≫ random 0.5), analogy is resonance, probabilistic inference is noisy settling — 4/5 [V].

chapters.title: L5 — dual learning systems: a fast episodic store and a slow semantic store
chapters.one_liner: Offline replay builds a separate persistent slow store that cuts catastrophic forgetting; as an independent context channel it closes L4's open limit (strict ≈ 1.0 ≫ content 0.68).

chapters.title: L6 — a self-supervised world model: prediction is forward settling, error is the learning wave
chapters.one_liner: The field predicts its own next state by forward settling and learns from the difference wave: held-out error falls 0.978→0.126, rollout is faithful to horizon 12, and a forward model beats reactive recall by directionality.

chapters.title: L7 — embodiment and real-time control: control is continuous settling, end to end analog
chapters.one_liner: In a clock-free analog loop, control is continuous settling: the forward model holds a moving target through delay, analog I/O beats ADC/DAC and the dimensional advantage scales (N×gap 4.6→42.1).

chapters.title: L8 — global integration and functional access: a resonant hub broadcasts the dominant pattern
chapters.one_liner: A global resonant hub selectively binds and broadcasts the dominant pattern (lock margin ≥0.92, non-source recall 1.0), routes any module flexibly, and shows a functional PCI inverted-U — the number R=0.39 not transferred.

chapters.title: L9 — functional general intelligence: the capability ladder and the end condition
chapters.one_liner: The integrated L0-L8 machine clears 6/7 capability rungs with the minimal store and 7/7 with the proven dual store wired in; A3 real-time adaptation is the lone single-store [O], closed inline.

chapters.title: The axiom-independence audit: eight inherited invariants compress to a minimal, irreducible five
chapters.one_liner: The 8 inherited invariants compress structurally onto 5 operational L0 axioms; nulling each one (paired, 6 seeds, gated by a passing control) collapses a core capability — all five load-bearing, the set irreducible.

chapters.title: Inheritance, methods, and provenance: what is inherited, what is not, and how to reproduce
chapters.one_liner: The wave machine inherits five brain invariants (B1-B5) and three physics invariants (P1-P3) as cited principles, never fitting targets; everything reproduces bit-for-bit from twelve pinned digests.
